nodes.title: Текст кадра 3
widgets_values:
refcontrol. Follow the exact hand shape and finger positions from image 1. Take the costume colours and the art style from image 2.

Dramatic extreme close-up. A single white-gloved right hand fills the frame at the instant of a finger snap: the thumb slides off the pad of the middle finger, the index finger tucked beside them, the last two fingers curled down.

A blue military cuff with gold trim, and a pentagram transmutation circle drawn on the back of the glove. A small spark flickers between the fingertips.

Speed lines radiate outward from the hand, a dark blurred forest behind.

Keep the upper part of the panel simple and empty: blurred dark background only. Pure illustration.

nodes.title: Текст кадра 1
widgets_values:
Wide manga panel. Two characters face each other in a dark forest, the Hogwarts castle visible in the distance between them.

On the left: Harry Potter from image 2, a small 7-year-old boy with round glasses and a lightning scar on the forehead, in a school uniform and a dark red sweater.

On the right: Roy Mustang from image 1, a 25-year-old man with black hair, in a blue military coat with white gloves. The pentagram transmutation circle appears on the gloves only, the rest of the coat is plain.

Both keep their arms relaxed and hanging down at their sides, hands open and lowered. A tense stand-off, they hold eye contact.

Keep the upper-left corner of the panel simple and empty: open sky and distant treetops only. Pure illustration.

nodes.title: Текст кадра 2
widgets_values:
refcontrol. Follow the body pose and the hand shape from image 1. Take the character, the face and the clothing from image 2. Don't take any face lines from image 1 - only pose. Also make boy look smaller height, than image 1

Medium shot from a slightly high camera angle. Harry Potter, an 8-year-old boy with round glasses and a lightning scar on his forehead. He should look like a small slighlty frightned child, use image 2 as a ref

He is looking straight into the camera at his opponent: his face is turned to the viewer, his chin lifted toward the lens, both eyes wide open and clearly visible behind the round glasses, holding direct eye contact. His head is not tilted down and his eyes are not lowered, he does not look at his own hand or at the ground.

His right arm reaches toward the camera, the hand caught mid snap: the thumb presses against the pad of the middle finger, the index finger tucked beside them, the last two fingers curled down. It is a small boy's bare hand, the fingertips drawn plainly in the same flat skin tone as the rest of the hand.

His left arm hangs down at his side, holding a magic wand, pointed down to the ground.

A drop of sweat runs down his cheek, he is nervous but he keeps staring forward. A dark forest behind him.

Keep the upper-right corner of the panel simple and empty: plain blurred background only. Pure illustration.
